post.originalText:
Physical AI is moving very fast, this is the test I did.

My prompt was a mess: "I want to see how we can manage a swarm of IoT and agentic-physical AI look like at home and we can use Mia's UI to manage everything: Water the plants, check on the baby, make sure the oven is off, and how is the Tesla?" 

I think I'll test this a little bit more. I used Opus 5.5 + three.js + https://t.co/Wuc7cWLFR8
